reviews.body:
LGTM. The shared default now lives in types.go, and both Azure request paths use newRequest to preserve the default top_p behavior while sending custom values. The request-body tests cover default omission and a custom value, and all six checks are green.

Please close https://github.com/KusionStack/karpor/pull/870 as a duplicate so we track this fix here.

review_comments.body: nit: defaultTopP is declared in openai.go but now also used by azureopenai.go, so it reads like the Azure client depends on the OpenAI one. Since it's a shared default across providers, could we move const defaultTopP = 1 into types.go? That makes the dependency explicit and keeps both clients referencing the same source.

comments.body:
Good point, thanks. Moved `defaultTopP` to `types.go` so both clients reference the same shared default. No other change; `go vet` and the `pkg/infra/ai` tests pass.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
